Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Jr. Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the IIT Delhi recruitment is Jr. Research Fellow. This is a contractual position for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Jr. Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Jr. Research Fellow post at IIT Delhi. This is a single opening announced in the latest recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Jr. Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Jr. Research Fellow position is Rs. 37,000 Per Month, plus HRA at 27%.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Jr. Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a Post Graduate Degree in basic science with NET qualification, or a Graduate Degree in a professional course with NET qualification, or a Post Graduate Degree with a professional course.

faq.question: Q6. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 21 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Jr. Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Test and/or Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the IIT Delhi located?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110016.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).
